title: Basement Waterproofing Marketing: How Companies Turn Ad Spend Into Booked Jobs — Explore Agency

facts.fact: The emergency call funnel has a close timeline of same day to 48 hours, according to the page.
facts.quote: Close timeline runs same day to 48 hours.

facts.fact: The planned installation funnel has a close timeline of two to six weeks, according to the page.
facts.quote: Close timeline runs two to six weeks across two or three in-home estimates.

facts.fact: Planned waterproofing jobs involve two or three in-home estimates before the close, according to the page.
facts.quote: Close timeline runs two to six weeks across two or three in-home estimates.

facts.fact: The page cites a callback in under 15 minutes as the response-speed threshold for emergency leads, contrasted with a callback at 4 hours.
facts.quote: a callback in under 15 minutes functions differently than one at 4 hours when a homeowner has standing water.

facts.fact: The page states that a lead called back in under 15 minutes typically has a higher close rate than one reached hours later, without giving a close-rate figure.
facts.quote: A lead called back in under 15 minutes typically has a higher close rate than one reached hours later

facts.fact: The page recommends tracing 40 recent form fills through the CRM to see how many became booked estimates, signed jobs, and Google reviews.
facts.quote: Trace 40 recent form fills through your CRM.

facts.fact: The page lists Google Ads call-only campaigns and Local Services Ads as the primary channels for the emergency call funnel.
facts.quote: Primary channels are Google Ads call-only campaigns and Local Services Ads.

facts.fact: The page lists local organic SEO, retargeting, and post-estimate follow-up sequences as the primary channels for the planned installation funnel.
facts.quote: Primary channels are local organic SEO, retargeting, and post-estimate follow-up sequences.

facts.fact: The page defines cost per booked job, rather than cost per lead, as the metric that shows what a channel costs to produce revenue.
facts.quote: Cost per booked job, not cost per lead, is the number that tells you what a channel actually costs to produce revenue.
